summary: [P1] Outdated software with known vulnerabilities on Perimeter firewall / VPN (vpn.novarefino.example:443)
steps: Confirm the exact installed version and the vendor advisory for every CVE listed.
Apply the vendor fixed release (or the supported LTS branch) through the normal change process; emergency change if the CVE is in CISA KEV.
If patching must wait, apply the vendor workaround or put the service behind an allowlist / WAF virtual patch and document the compensating control with an expiry date.
Add the component to the software inventory (SBOM / CMDB) so the next advisory is matched automatically.
verify: Re-run the version detection scan (nmap -sV --script vulners) and confirm the banner or package reports the fixed version.
Re-run the original exploit check (non-destructive) and confirm it fails.

summary: [P1] Legacy SMBv1 enabled / SMB exposed on HR file server (fs01.corp.novarefino.example:445)
steps: Disable SMBv1 on the server and clients (Windows feature removal or GPO) after checking that no legacy device still depends on it.
Scanner guidance: Apply the vendor security update for SMB server and disable SMBv1.
Install the cumulative security update that covers the listed CVEs.
Restrict TCP 445 to the subnets that need file services; never expose it to the internet or to the OT zone.
verify: nmap -p445 --script smb-protocols <host> must not list SMBv1 (NT LM 0.12).
nmap -p445 --script smb-vuln-ms17-010 <host> must report not vulnerable.

summary: [P2] Sensitive or personal data exposed (public storage, backups, listings) on Supplier portal (suppliers.novarefino.example:443)
steps: Remove public access to the storage/backup location immediately and keep a copy of access logs as evidence.
Rotate any secrets found inside the exposed files.
DPO assesses whether personal data was accessed and whether a GDPR Art. 33 notification (72 hours) is required.
Enable encryption at rest and a policy that blocks public buckets/shares by default.
verify: Anonymous request to the object/share URL returns 403.
Cloud posture scan shows the 'block public access' control enabled.

summary: [P2] Database or cache service reachable without network restriction on ERP database (erp-db01.corp.novarefino.example:1433)
steps: Bind the service to the application subnet only and add a host firewall rule allowing just the app servers.
Require authentication and TLS for every client connection; remove anonymous or default accounts.
Move the database into a dedicated data tier segment if it currently shares the user VLAN.
verify: From a user-VLAN host, nmap -p <db port> <host> must report filtered.
Unauthenticated connection attempt must be refused.

summary: [P4] Weak TLS configuration (old protocol versions or ciphers) on Citrix gateway (portal.novarefino.example:443)
steps: Disable SSLv3, TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1; keep TLS 1.2 with AEAD ciphers and TLS 1.3.
Scanner guidance: Enable TLS 1.2 or 1.3 only.
Replace self-signed or expiring certificates with certificates from the corporate or public CA and automate renewal.
Apply the change through a shared hardening baseline (Ansible/GPO) so every web front end gets it.
verify: nmap --script ssl-enum-ciphers -p443 <host> must show no TLS 1.0/1.1 and grade A ciphers only.
testssl.sh <host> shows no high or critical items.

summary: [P4] Cleartext management or file-transfer protocol in use on Control room printer (prn-ctrlroom.corp.novarefino.example:21)
steps: Replace Telnet with SSH and FTP with SFTP/FTPS; disable the cleartext daemon after migration.
Rotate every credential that was ever used over the cleartext protocol.
Block the cleartext port at the host firewall so it cannot be re-enabled silently.
verify: nmap -p 21,23 <host> must report closed/filtered.
Confirm that the replacement encrypted service accepts logins with rotated credentials.
